public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline. The reviewed exit reports do not establish how much investors have recovered from the specified four-year AI-startup cohort, or what they can ultimately recover. Broader startup exits neither refute aggregate losses nor prove recovery of the claimed $800 billion. No decisive event meeting the early-resolution rule was found.
limitations: The investment denominator, cohort boundaries and accounting basis remain unverified.
Public exit values and private valuations are not realized investor distributions.
An interim shortage of exits cannot establish permanent losses.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The roughly $800 billion invested in AI startups over the past four years has no real hope of being recovered.

statement.excerpt: And there really is no hope for the $800 billion or so invested in AI startups in the last four years, as AI acquisitions are thin thanks to their high costs, miserable revenues and utter lack of intellectual property.

from_speaker: $800 billion or so invested in AI startups
high costs, miserable revenues and utter lack of intellectual property
our_interpretation: The normalized claim predicts that investors will fail to recover the aggregate capital invested in the identified AI-startup cohort.
No hope is read as a forecast of substantial permanent aggregate losses, not a claim that every individual investment returns zero.
The preceding four years is read as October 6, 2022 through October 6, 2026. Calendar-year totals for 2022–2026 would cover a different cohort.
The dollar amount is read as US dollars. Geography, financing instruments, fees and the definition of an AI startup are unspecified.
Recovery means realized proceeds attributable to the original investment cohort. New financing, paper valuations and IPO market capitalizations are not themselves investor recovery.
The surrounding phrase next few years is not imported as a deadline because it describes other companies and failures.
criteria.support_condition: Cohort-level realized proceeds, final write-offs and bounded remaining recoveries establish substantial permanent losses on the aggregate invested capital. Limited exits at an interim date do not suffice.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Documented realized proceeds attributable to this investment cohort recover approximately its verified aggregate invested capital. Individual successful exits alone do not suffice.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Verified cohort-level realized distributions sufficient to recover the invested capital, or final realizations and write-offs establishing substantial permanent aggregate losses after remaining claims are accounted for.
